attchmntText: The Exchange has sought clarification from Era Infra Engineering Limited for the quarter ended 30-Sep-2026 with respect to Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. On basis of above the Company is required to clarify the following:  The response of the Company is awaited.

Era Infra Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Clarification regarding the appointment of the Compliance Officer of the Company.'  In this regard, we wish to clarify that Ms. Arunima Trigunayat was appointed as the Company Secretary and Key Managerial Personnel of the Company with effect from May 12, 2025, pursuant to the approval of the Board under Section 203 of the Companies Act, 2013.Upon relisting of the Company's securities on the recognised stock exchanges in December 2025, Ms. Arunima Trigunayat, being the existing Company Secretary and Key Managerial Personnel of the Company, was entrusted with the responsibilities of the Compliance Officer in terms of Regulation 6(1) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. Accordingly, no separate announcement was made in respect of her appointment dated May 12, 2025, as the Company was not listed on the said date.However, pursuant to the advice of the Stock Exchange, the Company is now making the requisite announcement in this regard for your information and records.We request you to kindly take the above clarification on record.
Era Infra Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
Era Infra Engineering Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
